summary: Ran the full unit and integration suite against the exact declared versions from a clean rebuild, and closed the ADR-013 provider-contract coverage gap for task 7.1. The declared stack was used as pinned: net10.0 with the SDK pinned by global.json to 10.0.0 (rollForward latestMinor), Jellyfin.Controller/Jellyfin.Model 12.0.0 with manifest targetAbi 12.0.0.0, SkiaSharp 3.119.4 for the linux-x64 plugin RID, xunit 2.9.3, Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk 18.10.1, xunit.runner.visualstudio 3.1.5, and plugin version 0.1.0.0. Validation removed src/tests bin/obj and ran ./build.sh restore, ./build.sh build, and ./build.sh test: build succeeded with 0 warnings / 0 errors and the suite reported Failed 0, Passed 1215, Skipped 58, Total 1273, exactly +18 over the Phase 6 baseline (1197/58/1255) with the same 58 environment-guarded skips and no regressions. Coverage assessment: the declared Sonarr 3.x-4.x and Radarr 3.x-6.x lines were not previously exercised as such (existing probe tests only used Sonarr 4.0.0, Radarr 5.3.0, and generic drift versions 99.0.0/5.0.0), fully populated payloads existed only at the read level (RadarrClientTests, SonarrClientTests) and were never mapped end-to-end per declared line, and sparse/optional-missing payloads existed only at the read level (ProviderFailureMatrixTests) and were never mapped to explicit unknowns. Added tests/ArrTags.Tests/ProviderContractFixtureTests.cs (18 cases) with no production change: a probe theory across all six declared lines that asserts the observed version is recorded with no numeric gate and the /api/v3 contract is used, a fail-closed theory that a missing required identity field (appName) yields ProviderIncompatible/Incompatible for every declared line, and per-provider fully-populated and sparse/optional-missing contract facts that read through the real clients and map through RadarrMetadataMapper/SonarrMetadataMapper, asserting canonical values for the populated payload and explicit unknowns (null quality/resolution/dynamic-range/codec/audio/audioFeatures, empty custom badges) for the sparse payload, plus explicit absent file identity when the record has no file. docs/changelog.md records the task 7.1 result and the new fixtures.

known_limitations: No live Sonarr/Radarr instance and no live Jellyfin host were exercised. The declared provider lines are covered at the provider-contract-fixture (unit/integration) level against the pinned /api/v3 JSON shape, consistent with ADR-013's behavioural (no version-number gate) compatibility model.

The sparse/optional-missing and fully-populated payloads are representative contract fixtures, not exhaustive per-minor-release captures; the exact strings are line-representative versions (Sonarr 3.0.0/4.0.0, Radarr 3.0.0/4.0.0/5.0.0/6.4.0). Because the probe records the version without a numeric gate, the fixtures demonstrate the contract path, not each release's complete field set.

The required-field fail-closed path exercised by the new fixtures is the connection identity field (appName) that ADR-013 makes the compatibility gate. Malformed JSON, empty/null bodies, and oversized read responses continue to be classified as ArrProviderErrorCode.InvalidResponse by the existing task 2.7 failure matrix; the new fixtures do not change or reinterpret that read-level classification.

The 58 environment-guarded skips (host-guarded Jellyfin facts, native-Skia facts, packaged-plugin facts, and the non-canonical cross-runtime comparison) still do not run on this Alpine/musl environment; they are unchanged from the Phase 6 baseline and are not newly introduced by this task.
